news.headline: Marvell's $115 Billion Lumentum Deal Faces 50-50 Odds: Report
news.summary: Can Marvell complete its $115 billion Lumentum takeover? Merger specialists see only a 50% chance of success.

news.headline: Regal Rexnord is 'Worth So Much More,' Don't Overlook Churchill Downs: Jim Cramer
news.summary: Cramer favors Regal Rexnord and Churchill Downs, is cautious on Marvell, dismissive of Snap and unaware of Perimeter.

news.headline: 'This Is Not The Moment To Get Bearish': Morgan Stanley's Mike Wilson Sees Market Correction Nearing End, Stays Selective on Chip Stocks
news.summary: Last week’s crash wiped $3 trillion off the S&P 500, but Morgan Stanley’s Mike Wilson says the correction looks much closer to its end.
